name: Manjri
civicNote: Manjari Budruk was among the 23 villages notified into PMC (2020-21); Manjari Khurd is not in that list.
summary: A former village about 4 km beyond Hadapsar on Pune's eastern edge, now an industrial and residential growth area.
knownFor: Serum Institute of India facility and a special economic zone
connectivity: Manjari Budruk railway station on the Pune-Daund suburban section
suits: Buyers working in Hadapsar and east Pune who want newer housing at the city's eastern edge.
